subject: general
question: Which of the following is a tributary of Yamuna river?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chambal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Chambal River is a tributary of the Yamuna River in central India.

 
 
• The perennial Chambal originates at janapav, south of Mhow town, near manpur Indore.
 
• The total length of the Chambal river is 1024 kilometers.
 
• The National Chambal Sanctuary lies between in Dholpur.
